description: Creates a new discount coupon in Stripe with percentage or fixed amount discount. Use when creating promotional discounts for customers.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for creating a new coupon in Stripe. Either percent_off or amount_off must be provided.

amount_off.description: A positive integer representing the amount to subtract from an invoice total in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Required if percent_off is not passed.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

applies_to.description: Specifies which products this coupon applies to.

products.description: An array of Product IDs that this coupon will apply discounts to.
products.title: Products

applies_to.title: AppliesToData

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Required if amount_off is passed.
currency.title: Currency

amount_off.description: A positive integer representing the amount to subtract from an invoice total in this currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents for USD).
amount_off.title: Amount Off

currency_options.description: Coupons defined in each available currency option. Each key must be a three-letter ISO currency code.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

duration.description: Specifies how long the discount applies. 'once' applies to a single invoice, 'forever' applies to all invoices indefinitely, 'repeating' applies to invoices for a specified number of months.
duration.title: Duration

duration_in_months.description: Required only if duration is 'repeating'. Must be a positive integer specifying the number of months the discount is valid.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

id.description: Unique identifier for the coupon. If not provided, Stripe will generate one automatically.
id.title: Id

max_redemptions.description: A positive integer specifying the maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed before it becomes invalid.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about the coupon.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts. Maximum 40 characters.
name.title: Name

percent_off.description: A positive float larger than 0 and smaller or equal to 100 that represents the discount percentage. Required if amount_off is not passed.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Unix timestamp specifying the last time at which the coupon can be redeemed.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

inputSchema.title: CreateCouponRequest

name: create_coupon

AppliesToResponse.description: Details about which products the coupon applies to.

products.description: List of product IDs this coupon applies to.
products.title: Products

AppliesToResponse.title: AppliesToResponse

CreateCouponResponse.description: Response from creating a coupon in Stripe.

amount_off.description: Fixed discount amount in the smallest currency unit if applicable.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

applies_to.title: Applies To

currency.title: Currency

currency_options.description: Coupons defined in each available currency option. Keys are three-letter ISO currency codes.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

duration_in_months.description: Number of months if duration is 'repeating'.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Whether this is a live or test mode coupon.
livemode.title: Livemode

metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'coupon'.
object.title: Object

valid.description: Whether the coupon is currently valid.
valid.title: Valid
